name: Rewa Prasad
headline: Product-minded software developer specializing in Windchill customization, enterprise workflow automation, and modern web interfaces.
summary: Software Developer with 9+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise solutions across manufacturing, banking, and automation domains. Skilled in Windchill customization, Java, Spring Boot, React, and RPA implementations with a strong focus on user experience, process optimization, and scalable delivery.

highlights: Collaborated with solution architects and business analysts to gather requirements and translate them into technical design and implementation.
Worked extensively with PDMLink, PartsLink, Windchill customization, document management, and Oracle Fusion integrations.
Implemented change management workflows for change notices, change activities, and custom change object templates.
Developed custom validators, user pickers, data utilities, and lifecycle rules to streamline manufacturing data processing.
Built a React.js dashboard for PDMLoader validation with upload handling, business-rule checks, file processing, and downloadable ZIP reports.
Used Git, Jira, Azure Boards, and Rally for sprint and task tracking.
Built and optimized Kofax RPA robots for banking processes, integrating with Outlook mailbox via Microsoft Graph API and business applications.
Created Splunk dashboards to monitor robot performance, incidents, and production issues, enabling smarter operational responses.
Carried out load testing and root-cause analysis to ensure high performance and minimal disruption to business processes.
Worked in Agile ceremonies and acted as Scrum Master to improve team coordination and delivery flow.
Developed Java modules for archive communication and document retention using Nuxeo, Hadoop, and related backend services.
